sections.①:
• 브랜드명: Discord
  • 한 줄 정체성: 게이머에서 출발해 모든 커뮤니티의 거실이 된, 보이스+텍스트 채팅 플랫폼
  • 공식 디자인 철학: "Imagine a place — easy to talk every day, and hang out more often"
  • 시그니처 요소 1개: Blurple(#5865F2) Clyde + 서버 레일·채널 패널·대화 캔버스의 3단 공간 구조
sections.②:
• 핵심 키워드 3개: 친근함, 게이밍, 커뮤니티
  • 무드 설명: 라이트와 다크 테마 모두 톤이 다른 중성 표면으로 서버·채널·대화를 구분한다. Blurple 액션과 역할 색, 이모지, 둥근 아바타가 촘촘한 채팅 UI에 친근한 활기를 더한다.
  • 비주얼 스타일: 모던 미니멀 + 휴머니즘 (이모지/스티커/마스코트)
  • 밀도(Density): Compact — 채팅 위주
  • 모서리 성향: Round (16~24px 카드, pill 컨트롤)
  • 평면성: Subtle — 인접 표면 간 약한 톤 차이로 위계를 구분
sections.③:
:root {
  /* Primary - Discord Blurple */
  --color-primary-50:  #EEF0FE;
  --color-primary-100: #DCE0FE;
  --color-primary-200: #B9C0FD;
  --color-primary-300: #95A0FB;
  --color-primary-400: #7281F8;
  --color-primary-500: #5865F2;  /* Discord Blurple 기본 */
  --color-primary-600: #4752C4;  /* hover */
  --color-primary-700: #3C45A5;
  --color-primary-800: #313987;
  --color-primary-900: #232668;

  /* Secondary - Old Blurple (legacy) */
  --color-secondary-500: #7289DA;

  /* Neutral - Discord dark scale */
  --color-neutral-0:    #FFFFFF;
  --color-neutral-50:   #F2F3F5;
  --color-neutral-100:  #EBEDEF;
  --color-neutral-200:  #DCDDDE;
  --color-neutral-300:  #B9BBBE;
  --color-neutral-500:  #72767D;
  --color-neutral-700:  #4F545C;
  --color-neutral-800:  #36393F;   /* main canvas dark */
  --color-neutral-900:  #2F3136;   /* sidebar dark */
  --color-neutral-1000: #202225;   /* server list dark */

  /* Semantic */
  --color-success-bg: #DCF7E5;
  --color-success-fg: #3BA55D;
  --color-warning-bg: #FFF4D6;
  --color-warning-fg: #FAA81A;
  --color-error-bg:   #FCE4E4;
  --color-error-fg:   #ED4245;
  --color-info-bg:    #DCE0FE;
  --color-info-fg:    #5865F2;

  /* Status (Discord 시그니처) */
  --status-online: #3BA55D;
  --status-idle:   #FAA81A;
  --status-dnd:    #ED4245;
  --status-offline: #747F8D;

  /* Surface */
  --bg-base:     #FFFFFF;
  --bg-subtle:   #F2F3F5;
  --bg-elevated: #FFFFFF;
  --bg-overlay:  rgba(0,0,0,0.85);

  /* Text */
  --text-primary:    #060607;
  --text-secondary:  #4F5660;
  --text-tertiary:   #747F8D;
  --text-on-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --text-disabled:   #B9BBBE;

  /* Border */
  --border-default: #E3E5E8;
  --border-subtle:  #EBEDEF;
  --border-strong:  #B9BBBE;
  --border-focus:   #5865F2;
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
  /* Discord 다크 */
  --color-primary-600: #6E79F4;
  --color-primary-700: #828CF6;

  --status-idle: #F0B232;
  --status-dnd: #F23F42;
  --status-offline: #80848E;
  --bg-base: #313338;
  --bg-subtle: #2B2D31;
  --bg-elevated: #383A40;
  --text-primary: #F2F3F5;
  --text-secondary: #B5BAC1;
  --text-tertiary: #949BA4;
  --text-disabled: #5C5E66;
  --border-default: #1E1F22;
  --border-subtle: #2B2D31;

sections.④:
• 폰트 페어링:
    • 영문: gg sans (Discord 자체, 2022 이후 기본) / Whitney (legacy) / 폴백 -apple-system
    • 한글: Apple SD Gothic Neo / Pretendard 폴백
  • 위계:
    • Display: 48px / 800 / 1.1 / -0.02em (마케팅)
    • H1: 32px / 700 / 1.2 / -0.01em
    • H2: 24px / 700 / 1.25 / 0
    • H3: 20px / 600 / 1.3 / 0
    • Body Large: 16px / 400 / 1.5 / 0
    • Body: 14px / 400 / 1.43 / 0
    • Body Small: 12px / 500 / 1.33 / 0
    • Caption: 11px / 700 / 1.27 / 0.04em (uppercase)
sections.⑥:
--radius-none: 0;
--radius-sm: 3px;
--radius-md: 4px;     /* 메시지 hover */
--radius-lg: 8px;     /* 입력, 카드 */
--radius-xl: 16px;    /* 모달, 배너 */
--radius-full: 9999px;   /* 서버 아이콘 hover, 버튼 */
sections.⑦:
--shadow-none: none;
--shadow-sm: 0 1px 0 rgba(4,4,5,0.20);
--shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
--shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.30);
--shadow-xl: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.40);
sections.⑧:
• 스타일: Outline + Filled (Discord 자체 아이콘)
  • Stroke 굵기: 2px
  • 모서리 처리: Round (살짝 둥근 corner)
  • 추천 라이브러리: Lucide / Phosphor
sections.⑨:
Button

.btn {
  font: 500 14px/1 'gg sans', Whitney, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  height: 38px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  border: 0;
  transition: background 170ms ease, color 170ms ease;
}
.btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-600); }
.btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-primary-700); }
.btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--color-neutral-200); color: var(--text-disabled); }

.btn-secondary { background: var(--color-neutral-700); color: #fff; }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-neutral-800); }
.btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); }
.btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); }
.btn-danger { background: var(--color-error-fg); color: #fff; }

Input

.input {
  background: #EBEDEF;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 3px;
  padding: 10px;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
}
.input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-primary-500); }

Card

.card { background: var(--bg-elevated); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.card-elevated { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.card-outlined { box-shadow: none; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); }

Badge / Role pill

.role { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0 6px; height: 20px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 20px; }
.role::before { content:""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
.role-solid   { background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
.role-subtle  { background: rgba(88,101,242,0.10); color: var(--color-primary-500); }
.role-outline { background: transparent; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: var(--text-primary); }

.status-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }
.status-online { background: var(--status-online); }
.status-idle { background: var(--status-idle); }
.status-dnd { background: var(--status-dnd); }

Navigation (Server list + Channel list)

.server-list { width: 72px; background: #202225; padding: 12px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.server-list .icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 24px; background: #36393F; transition: border-radius 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; }
.server-list .icon:hover { border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-primary-500); }
.server-list .icon.active { border-radius: 16px; }
sections.⑩:
--duration-fast: 100ms;
--duration-base: 200ms;
--duration-slow: 350ms;
--ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
--ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
/* 서버 아이콘 morph (원→스퀘어) */
--ease-server: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
sections.⑪: 1. Blurple을 본문 텍스트에 사용 금지 — 액션/링크에만 2. role color를 무지개색으로 남발 금지 — 서버 역할의 의미 신호 흐림 3. 다크 모드에서 풀 white(#FFF) 메시지 텍스트 금지 — Discord는 헤더만 white 4. 서버 아이콘 hover에서 morph(원→스퀘어) 모션 제거 금지 — 시그니처 5. 마스코트 캐릭터를 임의 색으로 변경 금지 — Blurple 단일 색
sections.⑫:
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; font-family: 'gg sans', Whitney, 'Pretendard', -apple-system, sans-serif; color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--bg-base); }
  .discord-app { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 240px minmax(420px,1fr); min-height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; }
  .server-list { background: var(--border-default); padding: 12px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .server-list .icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-base); color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer; transition: border-radius var(--duration-base) var(--ease-server), background var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out); display: grid; place-items: center; font: 700 16px/1 inherit; position: relative; }
  .server-list .icon::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -12px; width: 4px; height: 0; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: var(--text-primary); transition: height var(--duration-base) var(--ease-server); }
  .server-list .icon:hover, .server-list .icon.active { border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-primary-500); color: #fff; }
  .server-list .icon.active::before { height: 38px; }
  .server-list .add { color: var(--status-online); background: var(--bg-base); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 400; }
  .server-list .divider { width: 32px; height: 2px; background: var(--border-strong); opacity: .45; }
  .channel-list { background: var(--bg-subtle); display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
  .server-name { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); display: flex; align-items: center; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .server-name span { margin-left: auto; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  .channel-scroll { padding: 12px 8px; }
  .section-label { margin: 12px 8px 4px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .channel { height: 34px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; }
  .channel:hover { background: rgba(128,132,142,.12); color: var(--text-primary); }
  .channel.active { background: rgba(128,132,142,.20); color: var(--text-primary); }
  .channel .hash { font-size: 20px; color: var(--text-tertiary); }
  .voice-live { margin: 10px 8px; padding: 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: rgba(35,165,90,.12); color: var(--status-online); font-size: 12px; }
  .voice-live strong { display: block; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 3px; }
  .user-panel { margin-top: auto; padding: 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.08); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; font-weight: 750; }
  .avatar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -1px; bottom: -1px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--status-online); border: 3px solid var(--bg-subtle); }
  .user-copy { min-width: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
  .user-copy small { display: block; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; }
  .main { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--bg-base); }
  .channel-header { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-default); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .channel-header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; }
  .channel-header .topic { padding-left: 12px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-default); color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 13px; }
  .header-actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 18px; }
  .stream { flex: 1; padding: 24px 20px 8px; overflow: auto; }
  .hero { padding: 34px 0 18px; }
  .hero-mark { width: 68px; height: 68px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-primary); color: var(--bg-base); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 38px; font-weight: 800; }
  .hero h2 { margin: 14px 0 6px; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .hero p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 15px; }
  .features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; margin: 8px 0 24px; }
  .feature-card { min-height: 116px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--bg-elevated); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
  .feature-card .glyph { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 16px; color: #fff; font-size: 17px; }
  .feature-card strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .feature-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; }
  .message { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 0; }
  .message .copy { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.42; }
  .message .name { font-weight: 700; }
  .message time { margin-left: 7px; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }
  .composer { margin: 0 16px 20px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--text-tertiary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 14px; }
  .composer .plus { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-secondary); color: var(--bg-base); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 20px; }
  .composer .tools { margin-left: auto; font-size: 18px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
  @media (max-width: 760px) { .discord-app { grid-template-columns: 64px 190px minmax(360px,1fr); } .features { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
</style>
